advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.intro: Advanced configuration for operators. These settings are optional — the defaults work for most deployments.
advanced.connectivityDescription: NOMAD periodically checks whether it can reach the internet. By default it probes Cloudflare's utility endpoint with a few fallbacks. Set a custom endpoint below if your network blocks the defaults. Leave blank to use the built-in defaults.
advanced.envOverrideMessage: The INTERNET_STATUS_TEST_URL environment variable is set and takes precedence over this setting. Remove it to manage the test URL here.
advanced.testUrlHelp: A single http(s) URL used to check connectivity. Any HTTP response counts as online.
advanced.testUrlProtocolError: Test URL must use http or https.
advanced.testUrlInvalidError: Test URL must be a valid URL (e.g. "https://example.com").
advanced.settingUpdateError: There was an error updating the setting. Please try again.

support.title: Support the Project
support.intro: Project NOMAD is 100% free and open source — no subscriptions, no paywalls, no catch. If you'd like to help keep the project going, here are a few ways to show your support.
support.coffeeDescription: Every contribution helps fund development, server costs, and new content packs for NOMAD. Even a small donation goes a long way.
support.networkHelpTitle: Need Help With Your Home Network?
support.rogueBannerAlt: Rogue Support — Conquer Your Home Network
support.rogueDescription: Rogue Support is a networking consultation service for home users. Think of it as Uber for computer networking — expert help when you need it.
support.starOnGithubReason: — it helps more people discover NOMAD
support.shareNomad: Share NOMAD with someone who'd use it — word of mouth is the best marketing
support.joinDiscordReason: — hang out, share your build, help other users

legal.title: Legal Notices
legal.thirdPartyIntro: Project NOMAD™ integrates the following open source projects. We are grateful to their developers and communities:
legal.kolibriDescription: Offline learning platform by Learning Equality
legal.cyberchefDescription: Data analysis and encoding toolkit by GCHQ
legal.qdrantDescription: Vector search engine for AI knowledge base
legal.privacyIntro: Project NOMAD is designed with privacy as a core principle:
legal.zeroTelemetryText: NOMAD does not collect, transmit, or store any usage data, analytics, or telemetry.
legal.localFirstText: All your data, downloaded content, AI conversations, and notes remain on your device.
legal.noAccountsText: NOMAD operates without user accounts or authentication by default.
legal.networkOptionalText: An internet connection is only required to download content or updates. All installed features work fully offline.
legal.contentDisclaimer1: Project NOMAD provides tools to download and access content from third-party sources including Wikipedia, Wikibooks, medical references, educational platforms, and other publicly available resources.
legal.contentDisclaimer2: Crosstalk Solutions, LLC does not create, control, verify, or guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of any third-party content. The inclusion of any content does not constitute an endorsement.
legal.contentDisclaimer3: Users are responsible for evaluating the appropriateness and accuracy of any content they download and use.
legal.medicalIntro: Some content available through NOMAD includes medical references, first aid guides, and emergency preparedness information. This content is provided for general informational purposes only.
legal.medicalNotSubstitute: This information is NOT a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
legal.medicalPoint1: Always seek the advice of qualified health providers with questions about medical conditions.
legal.medicalPoint2: Never disregard professional medical advice or delay seeking it because of something you read in offline content.
legal.medicalPoint3: In a medical emergency, call emergency services immediately if available.
legal.medicalPoint4: Medical information may become outdated. Verify critical information with current professional sources when possible.
legal.dataStorageIntro: All data associated with Project NOMAD is stored locally on your device:
legal.applicationDataText: Stored in Docker volumes on your local system
legal.dataStorageControl: You maintain full control over your data. Uninstalling NOMAD or deleting these directories will permanently remove all associated data.
